title: One changed card, one changed block
hook: A query can combine whole blocks with a few loose edges.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
doesNotKnow: Maintain range-sum blocks so point updates repair one block and queries scan only fringes.

misconception: Range sums require either a full scan or a binary tree.
objective: Maintain range-sum blocks so point updates repair one block and queries scan only fringes.

claims.text: A point update repairs just its own block sum. The query adds complete block summaries and scans only the loose edge cells, showing a middle ground between a full scan and a binary tree.
